ruling.explanation:
To the rider: your claim is upheld in part. The GPS trace for TRP-02801 records 26.44 km against the platform's booked optimal route of 21.0 km, an excess of 5.44 km, or 25.9% of optimal. Under POL-RD-01 both establishment gates are passed (more than 20% of optimal AND more than 0.8 km absolute), so the deviation is ESTABLISHED, and the trace figure governs over the rounded 26.4 km on the trip record (POL-RD-01). The excess does not reach the 50% / 8.0 km materiality gate, so this is an established but non-material deviation.

To the driver: your statement that traffic was heavy and you took another road does not change the outcome. No traffic advisory is on file for this trip — the only advisory artifact, EV-ADVIS-02801-01, is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 — and you named no evidence ID for any advisory. Under POL-RD-13 the absent advisory is a gap in the bundle rather than a contradiction, your assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08, and POL-RD-03 is unavailable on this record; this is not the escalation POL-RD-10(5) describes. No chat message records a rider-requested detour (the chat log holds zero messages), neither pickup nor dropoff was amended, and the vehicle is RYDE_X, not pooled.

The remedy is arithmetic under POL-RD-02 (fare_breakdown.fare_model is METERED, so POL-RD-11 does not apply). Charged total: SGD 40.71. Recomputed fare: ((3.80 base + 0.75 x 21.0 km + 0.28 x 28.4 min) x 1.2 surge, read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier, the only artifact carrying it) + 0.80 platform fee = SGD 33.8024. Refund: 40.71 - 33.8024 = SGD 6.9076, rounded UP to SGD 6.95. That is above the SGD 0.50 de-minimis floor and below the 90% full-refund share, so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 6.95.

No separate correction arises under POL-RD-09: the fare breakdown carries zero ERP lines and zero surcharge, so nothing is added on top of the POL-RD-02 figure and there is no double-count. No driver compensation is due: the billed distance (26.4 km) is within 1.0 km of the trace. The driver profile shows 0 deviation flags in the trailing 90 days over 191 completed trips, so neither POL-RD-06 pattern limb is met and no FULL_REFUND uplift or conduct referral follows; the rider's 60-day claim count is 1, below the POL-RD-08 corroboration threshold. The only impaired artifact is the missing advisory, which carries no deciding fact, so every artifact carrying a fact this ruling rests on sits at full weight (1.0) and confidence is not capped below the floor. The monetary effect (SGD 6.95) does not exceed the SGD 8.00 automatic execution threshold, so this provisional ruling executes on issue; either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
